children.text: Please use this ID instead of customer name
Enter the store and pick up the order.

For stacked orders, make sure to confirm picked up for EACH order as it is ready. If the store doesn't have the Pickup ID, ask them to check the tablet for the Customer's name (not Pickup ID) and order information.
Since you arrived before your pickup time, your on-time rate is protected for factors outside your control. To stay protected:
Pick up the order as soon as it's ready
